scope.adFind: Remains excluded from acquisition and acceptance under the separate Defender-blocked-tools instruction. No AdFind artifact was requested or inspected.

observed: The publisher's Current Version section identifies AdMod 1.29.00 dated June 8, 2026.

The publisher describes AdMod as a command-line Active Directory modification tool and lists Windows 7 / Server 2008 R2 or newer against AD, ADAM/ADLDS and other LDAP directories. This publisher statement is not RIDE target-support evidence.
The page documents fixes involving recursive tree deletion, DNS-record updates and password setting, and states that directory permissions govern modification access.
The AdMod row independently lists 1.29.00 dated 2026.06.08 with publisher MD5/SHA-1 values.
The file header says Updated: 2023.05.06; it is not a per-row update date and does not override the 2026 AdMod row.
The publisher documents add, modify, clear, rename, move, delete, undelete, password and security-descriptor operations.
The publisher warns that directory-modifying tools can be dangerous, recommends test-lab use, and documents a default object-count safety threshold that can be removed with -unsafe.
